scientific_integrity: The all-size one-edge factorization and the smallest-cycle proof are algebraic. A standalone exact rational verifier confirms 631 finite comparisons, which do not establish infinite assertions. No external validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: No globally optimal nonuniform five-cycle allocation is classified; Kemeny is for loopless discrete-time normalized-conductance walks, not the continuous-time Laplacian spectrum. Bibliographic priority may be affected by inaccessible unindexed historic weighted-cycle analyses.
title: A five-cycle Kemeny saddle invisible to every single-edge conductance scan
